decisions.scenario: Finding an entertainment attraction in east Cambridge

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: I'd like to find somewhere to go in the east part of town.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: I can suggest several options. Would you prefer an entertainment venue, a museum, a park, or something else?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Anything in the east is fine. Could you give me the address and type of one attraction?

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: How about Funky Fun House? It is an entertainment venue at 8 Mercers Row, Mercers Row Industrial Estate.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Sounds great. That's all I needed. Thank you!

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: You're welcome. Have a good day. Goodbye!

decisions.scenario: Finding a low-cost nightclub in the town centre

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: I'm looking for a nightclub in the centre of town.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: There are five nightclubs in the centre. Soul Tree Nightclub has the lowest entrance fee at £4.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: That sounds good. Could I have the address and postcode?

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Of course. It is at 1–6 Corn Exchange Street, and the postcode is CB2 3QF.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: No, that's all I need today. Thank you for your help!

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: You're welcome! Have fun. Goodbye!
